curation_log.rationale: Cluster 1 (abstract bias/fairness/objectivity, 11 variants/16 occ) and Cluster 2 (gender/stereotype/demographic bias, 22 variants/30 occ) are the same construct at two levels of specificity. The LLM split them because the embeddings cluster the demographic-specific instances separately, but the substitutability test is symmetric: any 'gender bias' criterion measures bias-and-fairness, and any 'unfair bias' criterion subsumes the demographic case.
